source: player knowledge, not derived from the wiki dump
note: Facts about creatures that change how their measurements may be combined. The wiki pack states one figure per creature; these say where that single figure is not the whole story.

depth_scaled.note: Creatures found on mine floors scale with depth, floors 1 to 9. A species bucket pools individuals of genuinely different size, so its envelope is a range over DEPTHS rather than over individual variation, and the wiki's stated figure is one depth rather than a nominal individual. Nothing in a combat log records the floor a fight happened on, so these cannot be separated after the fact - a fight on floor 9 and one on floor 1 are indistinguishable in the data.
